text:
An island was located on the planet Essien. Mount Savage was located on top of the island.

In 3962 BBY, the Mandalorian bastion was established on the island. The bastion became the target for an assault by the Galactic Republic Navy and the Phaeda Militia during the Essien landing.
title: Unidentified island (Essien)
